text: Implemented explicit typed NiftiCoordinateSystem/NiftiSpatialUnits and NiftiWriteOptions overloads for writeVol/writeVec; existing two-argument signatures and default header semantics preserved. MNI sform code4 and mm units caller-declared; qform unset, no registration inferred. Native imageJVM/test 247 and imageJS/test 234 passed on final source, exit0 log /private/tmp/plsneuro-nifti-coordinates-tests.log. New tests independently inspect bytes, affine/data roundtrip, and defaults. Uncommitted provider candidate retained in plsneuro tools/provider-patches/scalafim-nifti-coordinates.patch; no publication or consumer adoption claimed.
